object.attr: analysis: review Q44. A tool that fails after writing some files, such as `delete_object` stripping links in several documents, would otherwise commit half an operation; MELLON-STORE-SRS-175 proposes putting the files back. Confirm against 0.3.0; Implemented if 0.3.0 does this.
object.description: If a write tool called with `commit_message` fails, the MCP server shall make no commit.
